title: Noetherianity of generic formal fibres of regular power-series models
statement: The generic formal fibre of the regular power-series model is Noetherian.

proof.text: The localization at a prime of a regular local ring is Noetherian, hence its adic completion is Noetherian. The generic fibre is Noetherian by the Noetherian fibre theorem.

proof_origin.place: Proposition Tag 07PS, first two paragraphs; E2 uses the general Noetherian completion and fibre lemmas instead of the power-series model
